items.why: The VIX is surging as the tech-led slide deepens and the meltdown spills into other markets, with traders reaching for protection.
AMD is plunging after a 337 million-share resale filing added to the AI sell-off.
Nvidia keeps falling after its massive rally, with the chip rout continuing as confidence in the AI trade weakens.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 3.53% and S&P futures down 2.29% as the AI selloff deepens.
summary: Stocks are selling off sharply this morning in a tech-led slide as confidence in the AI trade weakens. The Nasdaq is down about 4% with chip names leading the drop, while hot inflation and new Trump tariffs add pressure.
